description: This PHP source file defines the class 'ModuleListProvider' within the namespace 'Api\V8\Helper'. It provides methods to retrieve and process a list of modules, including filtering based on user permissions and labels. The class interacts with global variables and external classes/functions such as 'query_module_access_list', 'ACLController', and 'ACLAction' to build a filtered, accessible module list with labels and access rights.

classes.name: ModuleListProvider
classes.description: Class providing the module list for the user, including filtering, labeling, and access rights.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of modules accessible to the current user, with labels and access rights.

methods.name: addModuleLabels
methods.description: Adds human-readable labels to each module based on language strings.

methods.name: removeInvisibleModules
methods.description: Removes modules from the list that are marked as invisible.

methods.name: markACLAccess
methods.description: Marks modules with their ACL access levels for the current user.

methods.name: buildAccessArray
methods.description: Builds an array of actions the user can perform on a module based on ACL levels.

methods.name: hasACL
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the specified ACL access level for a module.
